created_for: public benchmark validation after primary CTU13 publisher timeout (PR #136)
calibration_normal_assignment: First 25 percent of normal training rows assigned by SHA256(row bytes) modulo 4, remainder fit; no test rows used until model and threshold frozen
features: 11 fixed numeric pre-action features only; no attack labels, source/destination IP, or explicit attack signatures
test_outcomes: TP FP FN TN and unseen-label attack recall; unseen means attack-type string absent from published KDDTrain+ label set, not previously unknown to security community
scientific_limits: NSL-KDD is an old benchmark derived from KDD 1999; not current authentic production telemetry
Public GitHub repository is a nonpublisher mirror, pinned by git blob and immutable commit, not independently reauthenticated against original bytes
Calibration split is from the official training file, not disjoint operators or attack campaigns
No independently verified modern infrastructure labels, no concept-drift test, no zero-day claim
Outputs are learned anomaly suspicions, not confirmed hostile incidents or authorized responses
